backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing posts, media attachments, user profiles, and access control with admin‑gated CRUD and entitlement management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing affected files, components, and test IDs for a date‑correction UI requirement.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collected summaries of all frontend files, describing page components, hooks, utilities, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/style variables defining light/dark OKLCH color tokens and global background/foreground rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes for home, post detail, and admin with AppLayout wrapper.
Component that checks admin status and blocks unauthorized users with loading and denial UI states.
frontend/src/components/AllowlistManager: Admin UI for granting, revoking, and checking access by principal ID with validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App layout providing theme support, navigation, footer, and global toasts around page content.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Reusable error UI with retry support for failed async operations.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: II login/logout button handling authentication flow and React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery rendering image and video attachments via direct blob URLs.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploader.ts: Handles image/video selection and uploads media to a post with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with links, admin visibility logic, and auth button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated user is an admin using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, identity persistence, and status management via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for posts, access control, and media uploads using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for theming and typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for creating, editing, deleting posts, managing allowlists, and uploading media.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the home feed showing posts with loading, error, empty, and sorted-list states, including admin-only creation UI for empty feeds.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single post with loading/error handling, locked-content logic using Internet Identity, and optional media gallery.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Formats Unix timestamps into human‑readable Australia/Sydney dates.
frontend/src/utils/principal.ts: Validates and parses Dfinity Principal IDs with basic error reporting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash fragments, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, goals, issues, features, and architecture for the journaling site.
